WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_rev FROM customer_totals
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.customer_total,
    ct.customer_total / (SELECT total_rev FROM total_revenue) as customer_share
  FROM customer_totals ct
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(customer_share) as overall_avg_share FROM customer_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.customer_total,
    cs.customer_share
  FROM customer_shares cs
  WHERE cs.customer_share > (SELECT overall_avg_share FROM average_share_calc)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(aa.customer_total) as avg_amount_spent,
  AVG(aa.customer_share) as avg_share,
  AVG(aa.customer_share) - (SELECT overall_avg_share FROM average_share_calc) as share_beat_avg
FROM above_average aa
